en: This is a vintage black and white postcard depicting a wide city street called Storgatan in Sundsvall, Sweden. The image shows classic early 20th-century European architecture, a tram running down the center of the road, historic buildings with ornate facades, and a few early automobiles. Visible signage includes 'GRAND' and 'Sundsvall Storgatan.' The reverse side has pre-printed lines for address, a printed label indicating 'Norrlandstryckeriet, Sundsvall,' and the words 'EXTRA PRIMA Fotografi' with a mark indicating Swedish production.
